reviews.author: Alisha Gentry
reviews.text: This guy told us he could put our vehicle on the diagnostic machine to see what was wrong with it for 40 bucks, witch was outrageous enough. So we said you know what we got to figure it out so we went back and asked him to do it. He told us now it 120$. Definitely don't recommend.

reviews.author: Tiffany Cantrell
reviews.text: I’m so thankful for these guys being so helpful and getting me in last minute. They showed me the issue, kept me updated and as comfortable as possible while they fixed it, had it ready in minimal time, gave me the bad parts so I knew the work was done, and clearly explained everything when they finished. I wil definitely be back and highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: Dawn Morton
reviews.text: R & R are the best! They will do there best to make there customers happy. They do a great job of what they do and that is working on Automobiles. They give you a fair price. They are 2 brothers that get alone great. They also keep a clean shop. They are my mechanics. That means I trust them.

reviews.author: Natasha Rogers
reviews.text: If you want a company that is honest and professional use R&R Automotive. They treat each customer with care and as if you are family. I have used them for 7 years and always have had professional experiences and knowledge of what they are repairing and No surprise fees. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Judy Ford
reviews.text: Never go back there took my 88 bronco to get checked out on a Tuesday said it take a hour and a half and be 120.00 would call when done never called us went Thursday to see what was going on he said he everything was good he didn't do anything so didn't charge us .Got in noticed the review mirror was in the foot but went on home went out to check the water and couldn't believe the damage figured out the hood had blew back when they drove it .So up set they didn't tell us so Friday went back and ask why didn't they tell us passed it off as a old truck and I was responsible if they had wrecked it .So I don't recommend this place at all

reviews.author: kari jones
reviews.text: They are the only automotive shop we will go to. We have had the best experiences with R&R and have always been treated fairly with great service.

reviews.author: Deez Nuts
reviews.text: Alfredo is very rude and disrespectful. He lies takes your money break parts on your vehicle. Charges extra taxes.he broke my A/C Unit and told me after charging me 405.00 for some work that was done on the vehicle . finished with my vehicle and left it outside of his shop for hrs at a time dodge not contact me to verify with me that he was done with my vehicle.after I discovered that my A/C unit was not working in questioned home of it he got irritated with me and demanded me off of his property. Which left me with a broken unit.

reviews.author: Eleanor Montgomery
reviews.text: The guy is honest and thurough. He examined the problem and found the small brake leak. Very good rates on the job. We will be taking other vehicles needing work.

reviews.author: Alicia Blair
reviews.text: Wonderful service! Always explain things to me in a way I understand, being a woman! Love these guys! Would recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Humberto Rodriguez
reviews.text: It’s been really hot this summer and my A/C went out. They found my leak and have the correct machine to charge up my truck. Thanks, will come back again!

reviews.author: DarknLuvly G
reviews.text: Really cares about you and definitely know what they are doing. I highly recommend them to every and anyone

reviews.author: M Burriss
reviews.text: They get the job done real honest mechanics.. I recommend them if you need anything done to your vehicle
